chunk_summary: Semantic distillation is an agent/human task over every chunk; contracts require L0-L3, uncertainty, anti-triggers, and provenance before build.

l0.one_liner: Require an agent to read every chunk and author complete L0-L3 nodes with uncertainty and line provenance.

l1.brief: Deterministic scripts enforce coverage and provenance, while semantic interpretation remains explicit agent/human work.
safety_red_lines: Never market keyword extraction or deterministic chunking as semantic understanding.
uncertainties: Semantic correctness still needs source-aware review beyond structural validation.

workflow: Read the complete chunk identified by the queue item.
Author reusable knowledge nodes with L0 triggers, L1 brief/red lines, L2 workflow, and an L3 module.
Cite line ranges inside known chunks, record uncertainty and anti-triggers, then mark the work item complete.
Run completeness validation before registry build.
load_more_if: A node depends on another chunk or the source meaning is uncertain.

provenance.claim: Every chunk requires agent-authored L0-L3 artifacts and valid provenance before build.

uncertainties: The validator proves structural completeness, not that every semantic interpretation is correct.
